sources.title: Fine-tuning SmolVLA for Cube Pick-and-Place on SO-101
sources.snippet: Context # For the past few months I've been exploring different algorithms for my SO-101 robot arm to do a pick-and-place task. Last time I trained SAC with HIL-SERL (Human-in-the-Loop Sample Efficient RL) on the real robot with a reward classifier and human interventions via the leader arm. After about 750 episodes of training, HIL-SERL achieved 80% success on reach-and-grasp. That's good ...
